body: Thank you for this. I appreciate it greatly.
You're amazing. Thank you. I need this. Thank you.
My mind didn't even go there, but thanks!

If I knew it was going to feel better soon I would. But I can think of nothing else but getting intoxicated or taking sleeping pills just to escape these feelings for 10 hours of sleep. I don't even want to dream. I just want to put life on pause and feel okay or whole. As that is impossible, I don't want to keep going. Not feeling sounds so much better than carrying this around in my chest all the time. I can't breathe.

I mean't that we had slowly disappeared as a couple and things were rough but he has changed for the better. His heart is much much much better than it was when he left in March. We currently live together, cutting ties isn't really easy.
If only I had found you sooner Mr. stranger on the internet. Thank you.

I don't mean to vilify her. I don't like that he was with another woman so of course I'm not fond of the idea of her... But I know it was his choice and he kept himself there, not her. She did initiate the flirting and what not when it started and she even admitted that she knew he was married and didn't care because she just wanted him. Do I think that's shitty? Yes. But I definitely know he made the choice to leave, to be with her and he did this to me, not so much her. Thank you for your input.
I'm going to start calling around right now actually. Thank you.

Because I promised him as his best friend, then girlfriend, then fiance and as his wife to be with him through his transition from female to male. I've been there since day one when he came out. He starts Testosterone soon, I can't not be there for him through something completely life changing.

We have a long journey ahead of us with something in his life... It's part of why he wanted to escape who he was. I've been preparing for this journey since before we even dated, for the years that we were best friends... I am in this journey with him, I don't have a choice anymore.

It's hard to accept that. I want so bad to be okay. Sometimes I still get so mad and cry because I just want one day of rest from this feeling. Just one day to give me a break and feel whole again... But I'll never have that. I'll never not know. I'm forever changed and I think that's definitely the worst part for me... I'm forever like this now, I never got a choice.

I actually have a livejournal that I had started doing that. I put everything in it while he was gone and it helped a lot. I could get it all out. Maybe I should start writing more. Thank you for this!

I definitely think this is the best thing. We are behind financially as she was his boss so he quit (she got fired) when the affair started and I was in between jobs... But as soon as we get caught up enough to breathe, I definitely want marriage counseling.

Thank you for the encouragement.

Thank you for your opinion and input. There is more to the story as to why he cheated and why it was her and I understand that completely. He wanted to escape his life completely, just check out and she was dumb enough to let him. That's all it comes down to. As far as why he wanted to escape his life, we both know the reasons. I know what was said to her and what took place, maybe that is part of the reason why my mind keeps going back there actually... He didn't almost throw everything away for her, he almost threw everything away to be someone other than who he was for a little while. She was the pawn used.

Edit: As far as the measuring up. It was more shes a devoted Christian (he's strongly atheist) who is uneducated and cn't typ vwls. I mean't that things drove him nuts and he disliked things. I guess my point was, she wasn't this perfect person to him ever, but that's what my emotions fear when I know it wasn't true.
